- Partial refunds only work when the original has exactly one debit and one credit posting. Captures that split into fees or tax lines raise an error for a partial refund, because I don't know how you want the amount allocated. Full refunds work for any shape.
- Fee handling is not covered. If the processor keeps its fee on refunds, that needs its own postings.
